comment: Verified on a 2019 Tacoma (2GR-FKS 3.5L V6). Standard mode-01 PIDs plus odometer (PID A6) are read via functional OBD on 7DF->7E8; physical 7E0 does not respond on this truck, so they use the functional header (ATSH7DF) and must not use ATSH7E0;ATCRA7E8; as the Corolla/Sienna profiles do. This lists the supported standard PIDs that map to a parameter name in params.json; the truck also supports timing advance (010E), engine load (0104), long-term and bank-2 fuel trims, O2 sensors, catalyst temps, barometric pressure and control-module voltage, but those have no parameter name in this repo so are left to the firmware's generic standard discovery. Fuel level uses the combination meter (7C0 21 29, B3/2 litres) because standard 01 2F is not supported here; cross-checked against the dash gauge.
